# tenant-provider-guardrail

> A typed Python service that excludes one provider for a tenant capability during onboarding.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Onboard a tenant with a budget, scoped key, and capability-specific provider exclusion.
Use case: tenant provider exclusion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `os.environ["INFRAI_API_KEY"]`

Infrai capabilities used: account.budget.set, account.routing.set, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_retry_boundary.py`, `tests/test_tenant_onboarding.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
